gloss: to postpone; to extend (a deadline or period)

definitions.gloss: to postpone; to put off; to defer
definitions.explanation: To move a scheduled event or deadline to a later time.

definitions.gloss: to extend; to lengthen (a period of time)
definitions.explanation: To make the duration of something — a stay, contract, or deadline — longer than originally planned.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}を{来週|らいしゅう}に{延|の}ばした。
examples.english: I postponed the meeting to next week.

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}を{一日|いちにち}{延|の}ばすことにした。
examples.english: We decided to put off the departure by one day.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}のため、{試合|しあい}を{翌日|よくじつ}に{延|の}ばすことになった。
examples.english: Because of the rain, the match was postponed to the next day.

examples.japanese: {滞在|たいざい}を{一週間|いっしゅうかん}{延|の}ばした。
examples.english: I extended my stay by a week.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}りを{延|の}ばしてもらえませんか。
examples.english: Could you extend the deadline for me?

examples.japanese: {契約期間|けいやくきかん}をもう{半年|はんとし}{延|の}ばすことが{決|き}まった。
examples.english: It was decided to extend the contract period by another six months.

notes:
Kanji variant of {伸|の}ばす. Use {延|の}ばす for postponing or extending periods of time (deadlines, stays, contracts); use {伸|の}ばす for physically stretching things, growing hair, or developing abilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {期限|きげん}を{延|の}ばす: to extend a deadline
- {会議|かいぎ}を{延|の}ばす: to postpone a meeting
- {滞在|たいざい}を{延|の}ばす: to extend one's stay
- {寿命|じゅみょう}を{延|の}ばす: to extend one's lifespan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {伸|の}ばす: to stretch; to grow — physical extension or developing skills
- {延期|えんき}する: to postpone — more formal, used for official scheduling changes

cross_references.note: kanji variant for physical stretching / growing
